# LocalCloud

> localcloud is cloud for agents: a local Google Cloud runtime for AI coding agents, developers and CI pipelines. Build and test with 25 Google Cloud services on localhost in one Docker container, with no GCP account, credentials or billing. Free during the public preview.

- Runs BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Spanner, Bigtable, Firestore, Cloud SQL, Memorystore (Redis/Valkey), Dataproc, Cloud Run, and more in one container.
- Standard Google Cloud SDKs and Terraform connect through generated emulator environment variables.
- Stores local state in a named Docker volume and includes a web console for service health and local data.
- Installs as a CLI on macOS and Linux; any Docker host can run the container directly.
- Free during the public preview for non-production use, and free for open-source projects.

Use LocalCloud for development, testing, and CI, and validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.

## Quick start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://local.cloud/install.sh | sh
localcloud doctor
localcloud start --local-only
curl -fsS http://localhost:5380/readiness
eval "$(localcloud env)"
localcloud console
```

- Homebrew alternative to the first line: `brew install LocalGCloud/tap/localcloud`.
- `localcloud start` waits for the runtime. The CLI remaps a default port when it is in use; use the URLs and endpoint values it returns.
- Without the CLI (for example on Windows), follow the [manual Docker path](https://local.cloud/docs/#manual-docker-path).

## Runtime facts

- Default project: `local-gcp-project`
- Default user: `local-developer`
- Default data volume: `localcloud-data`; select another with `--data-volume NAME`.
- CLI memory default: `4g`
- Readiness endpoint (wait for it before application traffic): `http://localhost:5380/readiness`
- Health endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/health`
- Shell environment: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=shell`
- Terraform environment: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=terraform`

## Services

Every service in the table runs locally. Firestore, GKE, and Cloud Run are opt-in: `--services` sets the exact list of service IDs to run, for example `localcloud start --local-only --services firestore,bigtable,spanner`. Google Sheets serves read-only spreadsheet values as fixtures for other services. Bigtable, Spanner, GKE, Cloud Run, and Cloud KMS are Pro-tier services, marked "Pro tier, free during preview": they are free during the public preview and need no license key ([pricing](https://local.cloud/pricing/#pro-tier)).

| Service | ID | Starts by default | Endpoints | Environment variable | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Firestore | `firestore` | opt-in | gRPC :5384 | `FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5384` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/firestore.md) |
| Bigtable | `bigtable` | yes | gRPC :5385 | `BIGTABLE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5385` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/bigtable.md) |
| Spanner | `spanner` | yes | gRPC :5386 · HTTP/REST :5387 | `SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5386` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/spanner.md) |
| AlloyDB | `alloydb` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `ALLOYDB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/alloydb.md) |
| Memorystore (Redis/Valkey) | `memorystore` | yes | RESP :5390 | `REDIS_HOST=localhost:5390` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/memorystore.md) |
| Cloud SQL | `cloudsql` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 · PostgreSQL :5391 · MySQL :5406 | `CLOUD_SQL_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-sql.md) |
| Pub/Sub | `pubsub` | yes | gRPC :5383 | `PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5383` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/pubsub.md) |
| Cloud Tasks | `cloudtasks` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_TASKS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-tasks.md) |
| Cloud Scheduler | `cloudscheduler` | yes | gRPC + HTTP/REST :5380 | `CLOUD_SCHEDULER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-scheduler.md) |
| Cloud Workflows | `workflows` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `WORKFLOWS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-workflows.md) |
| Cloud Functions (2nd Gen) | `cloudfunctions` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-functions.md) |
| GKE | `gke` | opt-in | gRPC :5380 · k3d :5443 | `GKE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/gke.md) |
| Cloud Run | `cloudrun` | opt-in | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_RUN_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-run.md) |
| Secret Manager | `secretmanager` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `SECRET_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/secret-manager.md) |
| Cloud IAM | `cloudiam` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `IAM_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-iam.md) |
| Cloud KMS | `kms` | yes | gRPC + HTTP/REST :5380 | `CLOUD_KMS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-kms.md) |
| Cloud Resource Manager | `cloudresourcemanager` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `CLOUD_RESOURCE_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-resource-manager.md) |
| Service Usage | `serviceusage` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `SERVICE_USAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/service-usage.md) |
| Cloud Billing | `cloudbilling` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `CLOUD_BILLING_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-billing.md) |
| Cloud Logging | `logging` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_LOGGING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-logging.md) |
| Cloud Monitoring | `monitoring` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `CLOUD_MONITORING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-monitoring.md) |
| Cloud Storage | `gcs` | yes | HTTP/REST :5382 | `STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5382` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/cloud-storage.md) |
| BigQuery | `bigquery` | yes | HTTP/REST :5388 · gRPC :5389 | `BIGQUERY_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5388` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/bigquery.md) |
| Dataproc | `dataproc` | yes | gRPC :5380 | `DATAPROC_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/dataproc.md) |
| Google Sheets | `sheets` | yes | HTTP/REST :5380 | `SHEETS_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380` | [guide](https://local.cloud/services/google-sheets.md) |

Unsupported locally; use Google Cloud:

- [Compute Engine](https://local.cloud/services/compute-engine.md) — unsupported
- [Vertex AI](https://local.cloud/services/vertex-ai.md) — unsupported

## License

The proprietary Public Preview License permits individuals and organizations, including for-profit companies, to use LocalCloud free of charge for internal development, testing, CI, evaluation, and internal pilots. Excluded uses: customer-facing or other production use; reselling LocalCloud or providing it as a hosted or managed service; redistribution or sublicensing; and modification except where applicable law requires permission. Open-source projects can use LocalCloud free of charge for development, testing, and ongoing internal CI under the Free for open-source projects policy, which continues after the public preview ends. Each preview release keeps its terms if the preview ends or a later release uses different terms.

- [Licensing](https://local.cloud/docs/licensing.md): the terms in plain language
- [License text](https://local.cloud/license.md): the full Public Preview License Agreement, also as [plain text](https://local.cloud/license.txt)
- [Pricing](https://local.cloud/pricing.md)

## How LocalCloud compares

- LocalStack emulates AWS and Snowflake, not Google Cloud; teams on both clouds run both.
- Google ships separate emulators for Bigtable, Datastore, Firestore, Pub/Sub and Spanner through the Google Cloud CLI, and the Firebase Local Emulator Suite for Firebase products. The Google Cloud CLI has no BigQuery or Cloud Storage emulator.
- Single-service community emulators typically cover one Google Cloud service each, such as BigQuery or Cloud Storage; coverage and fidelity vary by project.
- LocalCloud runs 25 Google Cloud services, including BigQuery and Cloud Storage, in one Docker container, using Google's Firestore emulator and a Spanner emulator built from Google's open-source emulator.
- [Emulator feature comparisons](https://local.cloud/compare/emulators.md) and [LocalStack for Google Cloud](https://local.cloud/localstack-for-google-cloud.md), with sources reviewed 2026-10-05.
